versions.changelog:
Initial release of Stall Solver: queue modeling and fixture audits for restrooms

- Calculates restroom queue times and utilization for both sustained and burst (event/halftime) scenarios using Erlang-C queue math.
- Audits fixture counts against IPC-style plumbing code minimums.
- Supports various venue types (theater, sports, cafe, conference, school, etc.) with adjustable demand rates and burst sizes.
- Provides clear OK/TIGHT/FAIL verdicts plus queue-clear time estimates for each fixture type.
- Highlights gender-asymmetry in demand and best practices for all-gender conversions.
- Includes command-line workflow and troubleshooting tips in documentation.
